The '''Hand Baton CPD-12''' was a personal defense weapon manufactured by [[Bacnor Armaments]]. The rod shaped weapon emitted a stream of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] that liquified the outer casing of the weapon's ammunition canister. The combination create a blasting beam that was capable of stopping several attackers at once.
